Ticket:
Concerns regarding potential data visibility issue in patient portal

Hello, I am reaching out because we had an alarming situation happen today regarding patient portal accounts. While assisting a patient with a password reset, I noticed that their profile seemed to display information belonging to an entirely different individual. I am very concerned that data may have crossed over or been visible to the wrong person. Could your technical team investigate this right away to see if there was a data mix-up or a security issue with the portal linking?
